```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(nbadatar)
library(reactable)

my_theme <- reactableTheme(
  style = list(
    fontFamily = "-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif",
    fontSize = "12px"
  ),
  cellStyle = list(
    borderRight = "1px solid #e5e5e5",
    borderBottom = "1px solid #e5e5e5"
  ),
  headerStyle = list(
    borderRight = "1px solid #e5e5e5",
    borderBottom = "1px solid #d0d0d0",
    fontWeight = 600
  )
)

my_coldef <- colDef(
  align = "center",
  headerStyle = list(
    display = "flex",
    justifyContent = "center",
    borderRight = "1px solid #e5e5e5"
  )
)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
htmltools::tags$link(
  rel = "stylesheet",
  href = "https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Work+Sans:wght@400;600&display=swap"
)
```

Every column in the three tables, with what it holds and which seasons it
covers. Use the search box to filter, or click a column header to sort.

## Columns

```{r, echo = FALSE}
reactable(
  dictionary,
  filterable = TRUE,
  searchable = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 25,
  groupBy = "table",
  theme = my_theme,
  defaultColDef = my_coldef,
  columns = list(
    table       = colDef(name = "Table",       align = "center"),
    column      = colDef(name = "Column",      align = "center", minWidth = 120),
    type        = colDef(name = "Type",        align = "center", maxWidth = 90),
    description = colDef(name = "Description", align = "center", minWidth = 300),
    seasons     = colDef(name = "Seasons",     align = "center", maxWidth = 110)
  )
)
```

## Action type codes

The `msg_type` and `act_type` columns in the play-by-play data are numeric
codes.


```{r, echo = FALSE}
reactable(
  act_type_codes,
  theme = my_theme,
  defaultColDef = my_coldef,
  filterable = TRUE,
  searchable = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 25
)
```
